newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - April 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - April 23.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - China has set up a think tank for the People's Bank of China to help monetary policy-making.

- A senior official at the China Government Securities Depository Trust and Clearing Co, the newly-established national state debt depository, said the establishment of the depository will effectively check irregularities.

- The Shanghai branch of Japan's Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi and the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China have signed an agreement to provide a one-year, 30 million yuan loan to the Shanghai Sharp Electrical Equipment Co Ltd, the first jointly financed local currency loan involving a foreign bank in China.
- BUSINESS NEWS - Shanghai's fixed asset investment increased by a year-on-year 21 percent to 21.047 billion yuan in the first three months of this year.
